name: Securities Transaction Indicator 2
definition: Provides additional indicators on the transaction.

WaiverIndicator.name: Waiver Indicator
WaiverIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the transaction was executed under a pre-trade waiver.

ShortSellingIndicator.name: Short Selling Indicator
ShortSellingIndicator.definition: Indicates a short sell concluded by the investment agent on its own accounts or on behalf of a client, as described in the local regulation.

OTCPostTradeIndicator.name: OTC Post Trade Indicator
OTCPostTradeIndicator.definition: Indicates the type of transaction in accordance with the local regulation.

RiskReducingTransaction.name: Risk Reducing Transaction
RiskReducingTransaction.definition: Indicates whether the transaction is objectively measurable as reducing risks directly relating to the commercial activity of the entity executing the transaction.

SecuritiesFinancingTransactionIndicator.name: Securities Financing Transaction Indicator
SecuritiesFinancingTransactionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the transaction falls within the scope of activity to be reported under the Securities Financing Transactions Regulation.
